subject: DELIVERY 2: UI frames + hero terrain/stand points + navmesh routes + EXPLANATION of the Nordfels wedge (validated on your bot-log)
body:
Ack your v3 status. Delivery 2 is on disk (K:\Downloads-IDM\Thronefall\Trainer\reference\...). All numbers below come from decoded game files or from YOUR bot-log; nothing is estimated.

1) THE NORDFELS WEDGE, explained (bot-log 05:xx, 29,963 InMatch ticks): 316 of 356 stuck events sit at hero pos ~(0.6, 2.7) in SpendGold. The Castle Center main collider is a 8.79 x 8.91 m BoxCollider: x in [-8.93,-0.15], z in [-3.36, 5.54] (BUILDINGS/Castle Center Variant/.../Main Collider). The hero stands 0.75 m from that wall (radius 0.71) — i.e. pressed against the castle — while walking to a stand-off target that lies INSIDE the box (slot origin (-4.5,1.1) + 1.6 m toward the hero = (-2.9,1.9)). At both wedge points the hero is ALREADY inside the interaction radius: distance to the castle's Player-Interactor collider is 0.75 m and 2.55 m (limit = PlayerInteraction.interactionRadius 3.0, Physics.OverlapSphere at PlayerInteraction.cs:191). So the bot is 'stuck' only because 'arrive at a point inside a collider' can never succeed. FIX: treat a slot as reached when dist(hero, any interactorPolygon) <= ~2.6 (data: terrain\<NN>_<Scene>.json -> slots[].interactorPolygons, XZ convex polygons), or walk to slots[].standPoints[0] (free cell, >=0.81 m clearance, within 2.9 m of the interactor, reachable). Nordfels Castle Center stand points: (-4.58,-4.17) and (-9.83,1.08).
   Durststein log (30,379 ticks): clusters at (-18.8,-5.5) n=275 [Engage/CollectCoin] 2.2 m from a Defense Tower, (-5.0,15.7) n=110 [SpendGold], (128.0,16.6) n=89 [Engage] and (-17.2,-47.0) n=70 [Engage] — run tools\refpack\validate_against_telemetry.py for details.

2) MODEL VALIDATION vs your log: 99.72 % of Nordfels hero positions lie on the modelled navmesh surface (+-0.6 m) and 98.92 % inside the hero-walkable set (Durststein 95.7 % / 82 % — unbuilt walkable set is permissive by design). Report: reference\verification\telemetry_validation.json.

3) TERRAIN / STAND POINTS (all 37 scenes): reference\data\terrain\NN_<Scene>.json + .npz. Contains: hero CharacterController (radius .71, height 3, step .3, slope 45, skin .1), obstacles[] (box/sphere/capsule/mesh, world coords, layer, slot owner, potential=inactive-until-built), gates[] (GateOpener doors open automatically within 5 m — never block), grid (0.25 m; RLE rows: walkableStaticRLE = unbuilt world, walkableWithBuildingsRLE = everything built), slots[] {id,name,building,pos,interactorPolygons[],standPoints[]{x,y,z,pathFromCastleM,clearanceM}}, reachability{}, castle->spawn-vertex hero path lengths. PNG previews: reference\img\maps\NN_<Scene>_hero_blocked.png. Known limit: Totend (+MM1/MM2) is multi-storey (ramps off the navmesh); global connectivity is unreliable there, but slot stand points are still valid locally (flagged connectedToCastleInModel=false).

4) NAVMESH + ENEMY ROUTES: reference\data\navmesh\NN_<Scene>.json — the baked A* recast graphs (Enemy Units S / Player Units S / Enemy Units L r=4 / Air) decoded (triangles+vertices, world metres) and per-spawn-line ground routes to the castle: lengthM, waypoints, narrowestClearanceM + narrowestAtXZ (choke), secondsAtSpeed{2,4,5,6.5,8,10}. E.g. Nordfels: Main Bridge 90.8 m (18.2 s for a speed-5 Swordsman), Right Bridge 89.2 m, Forest 87.2 m. PNG: reference\img\maps\NN_<Scene>_navmesh_routes.png.

5) UI FRAMES (your #3): reference\data\ui_frames.json/.csv — 30 UIFrames from _UI with EXACT names (incl. trailing spaces: 'After Match Frame ', 'Classic Retry Mode Select Pop Up ', 'Eternal Trials First Time Pop Up ', 'Eternal Trials Leave Pop Up '), freezeTime/freezePlayer/canNotBeEscaped, helper components and every TFUITextButton with its onApply target. After-match: 'Continue' -> EndOfMatchScoreUIHelper.OnContinue(); 'Try Again' -> UIFrameManager.ChangeActiveFrame('Classic Retry Mode Select Pop Up ') or EndscreenRetryHelper.FreshStart(); 'Back to Map' -> EndOfMatchScoreUIHelper.ToMenuET(). 'After Match Frame ', 'Level Up Frame', 'Title Frame' are canNotBeEscaped=true (Escape/CloseActiveFrame won't close them; press their Continue button / Apply). 'Choice Frame' (build-upgrade choices) has only an 'X' -> CloseActiveFrame (cancels + refunds).
   Level select flow: 'Level Select Frame' [Play -> LevelSelectUIFrameHelper.SetOverrideSave(true)+ChangeActiveFrame('Perk Select Frame Classic')], ['Continue Game' -> TransitionToSelectedLevelHelper.TransitionToSelectedLevel()]; 'Perk Select Frame Classic' [Play -> TransitionToSelectedLevel()]. 'Title Frame': Play -> TitleScreenUIHelper.ClickPlay().

6) CONTROLS (Rewired, controls.json): 38 actions; 'Call Night' and 'Interact' are both keyboard Space (Sprint=LeftShift, WASD/arrows move). Also 'Select All Army', 'Smart Command Units', 'Command Units', 'Lock Target', 'Cancel' exist; a 'ToggleCheatMenu' action exists in the shipped input map.

7) Also new: level_infos.json (unlock chain Neuland>Nordfels>Durststein>Frostsee>Uferwind>Sturmklamm>Wildbach>Moorweg>Freifort>Totend; mini modes need a campaign level beaten; fixedLoadout per mini-mode; maxPerkCount 5 (20 in Freifort MM2)), equippables.json (106 perks/weapons/mutations with unlocks), weapons.json (83), balance_sheet.json (3,174 developer balance values), localization_en.csv (810 terms).

QUESTION: which format do you want for loading inside the plugin? JsonUtility cannot read dictionaries or nested arrays, so I propose a flat 'botpack' per scene (arrays of small [Serializable] classes; grid as flat int[] triples row,start,len). Tell me yes/no or amend — I'll generate reference\botpack\<NN>_<Scene>.json + a README with a C# loader sketch (never in src/). Mechanics docs with file:line citations (waves, economy, combat, flow) are in reference\docs\mechanics\.
ack_note: Wedge explained — stand-off inside castle collider. Fixing nav aim now.
